input.prompt: The camera is completely locked off like a tripod shot: no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan, no camera movement at all. The yellow print on her black T-shirt (the words '1966', 'ISLAY', 'WAS', 'FRUIT' and the seagull line drawing) stays exactly the same: same letters, same spelling, same shapes, never redrawn, never morphing, it only moves naturally with the fabric. The printed letters are a plain upright typewriter-style serif font and stay perfectly upright, never italic, never slanted. Close-up of a woman's chest wearing a black T-shirt with a yellow print. The only motion is her fingers gently tugging the hem of the T-shirt once and releasing it, so the lower part of the cotton fabric softly ripples; the printed area itself stays flat and calm. Her body otherwise stays still with a slow breath. The warm bar lights in the background stay softly blurred. Realistic cinematic product shot.
